newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Daehan Flour passes on 13,000T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Daehan Flour passes on 13,000T U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd passed on tenders to buy 13,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat due to high offer prices, a company official said on Friday.

But the official said the company bought 10,000 tonnes of Canadian western red spring (CWRS) wheat at $182.75 a tonne FOB from the Canadian Wheat Board through a private negotiation. He did not release any additional details.

The official said the 13,000 tonnes of passed U.S. wheat tenders were split into three lots -- 8,000 tonnes of western white/soft white (ordinary), 3,000 tonnes of hard red winter (protein minimum 11.5 percent) and 2,000 tonnes of dark northern spring (protein minimum 14 percent).
Shipment was set for July 5-August 5 to the western port of Inchon.
Traders said the lowest bids of the passed tenders were made by Japanese trading house Kanematsu Corp.

The Japanese company offered the 8,000 tonnes of western white/soft white at $176.10 a tonne FOB, the 3,000 tonnes of hard red winter at $187.30 a tonne FOB and the 2,000 tonnes of dark northern spring at $191.50 a tonne FOB.
